title: mcp-managed-tool-settlement-v1
description: A managed tool call's settlement record. It is an ordinary managed-settlement-v1 outbox entry, so it must validate against managed-settlement-v1.schema.json as well; this schema adds only the MCP mapping: request_id = generation_id = tool_call_id, provider mcp, model <server_id>/<tool>, endpoint_id mcp:<server_id>:<tool>, cost_source price_card or provider_reported, upstream_fee_bps 0, and one attempt <tool_call_id>.1 of kind primary on provider mcp:<server_id> with credential_type managed. Uses only the keywords internal/contracts/schematest supports.

attempts.description: Exactly one attempt, <tool_call_id>.1, primary, on mcp:<server_id>, credential_type managed.
